title: Enable pushing multi-arch Docker images to GitHub Container Registry
description:
Enable pushing multi-architecture Docker images to GitHub Container Registry (ghcr.io).

## Requirements

1. Update Justfile with GitHub Container Registry recipes:
   - build-ghcr TAG - Build image for ghcr.io
   - push-ghcr TAG - Authenticate with GitHub and push multi-arch image to ghcr.io
   - Recipes should handle both AMD64 and ARM64

2. Configure GitHub authentication:
   - Use GITHUB_REGISTRY_TOKEN environment variable
   - Support authentication flow similar to goldenbraid project

3. Justfile configuration:
   - ghcr_image variable: ghcr.io/dictybase/modware-stock
   - Support custom tags (default: latest)

## Success Criteria

✓ build-ghcr recipe builds image for ghcr.io
✓ push-ghcr recipe authenticates and pushes both architectures
✓ Images are tagged correctly with namespace and tag
✓ GitHub authentication works with token-based login
✓ Recipes follow goldenbraid project patterns

title: Implement multi-arch Docker builds
description:
Implement multi-architecture Docker image builds for modware-stock.

## Requirements

1. Create multi-arch Dockerfile (build/package/Dockerfile.multiarch):
   - Builder: golang:1.24-alpine with $BUILDPLATFORM
   - Runtime: gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12
   - Binary compression with upx (level 9)
   - Support TARGETOS, TARGETARCH build args

2. Create Justfile with recipes (following goldenbraid style):
   - build-multiarch     # Build both AMD64 and ARM64
   - build-amd64         # Build and load AMD64 locally
   - build-arm64         # Build and load ARM64 locally
   - test-amd64          # Build and test AMD64 (runs binary with --help)
   - test-arm64          # Build and test ARM64 via emulation (runs binary with --help)
   - setup-buildx        # Initialize Docker buildx
   - show-platforms      # Show available platforms
   - clean               # Remove built images

## Success Criteria

✓ Dockerfile builds successfully for both linux/amd64 and linux/arm64
✓ All Justfile recipes execute without errors
✓ test-amd64 and test-arm64 validate binary execution on both architectures
✓ Backward compatible (original Dockerfile untouched)
✓ No documentation files needed
close_reason: Implemented Dockerfile.multiarch and justfile with build/test recipes for both AMD64 and ARM64. No docs needed per user decision.
